deliverables: Full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Banking rails, stablecoin systems, wallet interfaces, API ecosystem layer, account abstraction, batched transactions, and settlement logic
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the vendor.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for enabling onchain payments and card infrastructure plus a 115,385 ada Intersect administration fee.
Wirex will deliver full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure connecting Cardano onchain settlement to banking rails, stablecoin systems, wallet interfaces, and Visa card issuance.
The proposed system is expected to let users spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants through Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, over $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount is asserted not to breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are said to be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties.

The treasury funds will be managed through a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract with specified multi-party authorization thresholds involving Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and six external oversight entities.
Wirex is stated not to have received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

The anchor document does not provide a complete feasibility assessment, risk analysis, alternatives analysis, failure-mode analysis, or detailed milestone budget beyond the single work package and administration fee.

summary: The document describes a 3,961,538 ada Intersect-submitted treasury withdrawal for Wirex payment infrastructure, with asserted adoption upside and smart-contract-based fund administration, but limited direct detail on feasibility, risks, alternatives, failure modes, and milestone economics.
